project.name: Dunninald
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict audit. Dunninald is an estate locality and falls to 18, selector-only. Castle and gardens remain a separately scored See attraction. No cafe, formal picnic site or exact Dunninald named-trail product was verified; the estate woodland walk, free attraction parking and courtyard accessible WC are published with explicit limits. All 14 local heritage records remain intact; nine are visibly dated and five period-unassigned NRHE records are hidden. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.
